description: Service-layer core of the decoupled model (foundation; no UI). Replace setMagicWordAndRepack with a pure setMagicWord (D1 — validate+store only, zero Drive ops); add an empty-contacts guard to backup() so empty local data can never overwrite the cloud even if the UI is bypassed (D6/D8/D13); add an overrideMagicWord param to restore() so the UI can retry a decrypt without persisting the entered word (D4b); add read-only cloud-inspection helpers cloudBackupModifiedTime() and cloudIsMagicWordProtected() for the D11 downgrade warning and D12 stale-restore warning. Add EmptyBackupFailure. Replace the 4 obsolete setMagicWordAndRepack tests and add guard/override/helper tests. Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level, but must land first because the UI feature (FEAT-003) calls these new signatures.
steps: In lib/core/errors/failure.dart add `class EmptyBackupFailure extends Failure { const EmptyBackupFailure([super.message = 'No contacts to back up']); }` near the other backup failures.

In lib/core/services/backup_service.dart replace setMagicWordAndRepack(String word) with `Future<Either<Failure, void>> setMagicWord(String word)` that ONLY validates+stores: call `await _magicWordService.setMagicWord(word)`, catch MagicWordValidationFailure -> left(e), other errors -> left(GeneralFailure(...)), return right(null) on success. Remove ALL Drive logic (oldWord capture, folderId/inFolderId/rootId/sourceId lookups, download/_codec.decrypt/_codec.encryptNew/uploadBackup repack block, the _migrateDeleteRootIfSafe call inside the old method, and the `sourceId == null -> backup(force:true)` branch). Delete the now-unused `_rollbackMagicWord` helper. Do NOT call BackupReminderService.markBackedUp().
Confirm _migrateDeleteRootIfSafe and _isReadableBackup are STILL referenced by backup() (migrate-then-delete block) — keep both; they must not become dead code.

In backup() change the signature to `backup({bool force = false, bool allowEmpty = false})`. After gathering `contacts` and BEFORE building the archive/uploading, add: `if (contacts.isEmpty && !allowEmpty) return left(const EmptyBackupFailure());`. Ensure this returns before any uploadBackup and before BackupReminderService().markBackedUp(); force:true must NOT bypass it (the guard is independent of the conflict check). Gate is contacts-only per D13 (do not also require profile==null).

Change restore() signature to `restore({String? overrideMagicWord})`; where it reads the magic word for decrypt use `final magicWord = overrideMagicWord ?? await _magicWordService.getMagicWord();`. No change to cloud behavior (restore still never writes cloud).

Add `Future<DateTime?> cloudBackupModifiedTime()`: resolve folderId via _resolveSecBizCardFolderId(), call _driveRepo.getBackupModifiedTime(_backupFileName, parentFolderId: folderId), return the time or null.

Add `Future<bool> cloudIsMagicWordProtected()`: locate the cloud file (prefer in-folder then root, mirroring restore()'s lookup), download bytes, call `_codec.readHeaderOrNull(bytes)`, return `header?.isMagicWord == true`; return false on any error (fail-open) and never decrypt beyond header parse or write anything.

In test/unit/services/backup_service_test.dart REMOVE the 4 tests calling service.setMagicWordAndRepack(...) and add: (a) 'setMagicWord stores the word and performs NO Drive operation' — seed a cloud file, call setMagicWord('mysecretword'), assert isRight, fakeMagicWord.getMagicWord()=='mysecretword', fakeDriveRepo.uploadCount==0, fakeDriveRepo.deleted isEmpty; (b) 'setMagicWord rejects an invalid word' — too-short word -> isLeft + MagicWordValidationFailure, stored word unchanged; (c) 'backup() aborts with EmptyBackupFailure when contacts empty' — getSavedContacts right([]) -> isLeft + EmptyBackupFailure, uploadCount==0; (d) 'backup(force:true) still aborts on empty contacts'; (e) 'backup(allowEmpty:true) uploads when contacts empty' -> isRight + upload happened.
Update the existing 'backup() with a magic word set writes magicword mode' test to seed ONE contact (so the new empty guard does not catch it) while still asserting encMode==magicword.

Add override/helper tests: 'restore(overrideMagicWord:) decrypts without persisting' (seed magicword file keySource 'correcthorse', no stored word, restore(overrideMagicWord:'correcthorse') -> isRight AND fakeMagicWord.getMagicWord() still null); 'restore(overrideMagicWord: wrong) -> WrongMagicWordFailure'; extend FakeDriveRepository.getBackupModifiedTime to return a settable time (default null to keep existing tests green) and test cloudBackupModifiedTime surfaces it; test cloudIsMagicWordProtected returns true for a magicword file and false for a uid file / no file.
acceptance_criteria: BackupService exposes `setMagicWord(String)` (pure store, no Drive op); `setMagicWordAndRepack` no longer exists anywhere in lib/ or test/.
backup() returns EmptyBackupFailure when contacts are empty and allowEmpty is false, including when force is true, and performs no upload and no markBackedUp on that path.
restore({String? overrideMagicWord}) uses the override for decrypt only and never persists it.
cloudBackupModifiedTime() and cloudIsMagicWordProtected() exist, perform no cloud write, and do not decrypt payload bytes.
`fvm flutter analyze` shows no new issues (no dead-code/unused warnings for removed helpers).
`fvm flutter test test/unit/services/backup_service_test.dart` passes, including the new guard/override/helper tests and the updated magicword-mode test.
verification: Run `fvm flutter analyze` from the worktree root — no new issues beyond the documented baseline.
Run `fvm flutter test test/unit/services/backup_service_test.dart` — all tests pass.
findings:
DONE. New/changed BackupService signatures (lib/core/services/backup_service.dart):
- `Future<Either<Failure, void>> setMagicWord(String word)` — PURE local store, zero Drive ops. Returns left(MagicWordValidationFailure) for bad word, left(GeneralFailure) otherwise, right(null) on success. `setMagicWordAndRepack` and `_rollbackMagicWord` are DELETED (gone from lib/ and test/).
- `Future<Either<Failure, DateTime>> backup({bool force = false, bool allowEmpty = false})` — new `allowEmpty` param. Empty-contacts guard: `if (contacts.isEmpty && !allowEmpty) return left(const EmptyBackupFailure());` placed AFTER gathering contacts, BEFORE archive build/upload/markBackedUp. Contacts-only gate (D13); `force:true` does NOT bypass it (guard is independent of the conflict check which runs earlier).
- `Future<Either<Failure, void>> restore({String? overrideMagicWord})` — decrypt uses `overrideMagicWord ?? await _magicWordService.getMagicWord()`; override is NEVER persisted; no cloud write.
- `Future<DateTime?> cloudBackupModifiedTime()` — resolves folderId via _resolveSecBizCardFolderId(), calls _driveRepo.getBackupModifiedTime(_backupFileName, parentFolderId: folderId); returns time or null. No decrypt/write.
- `Future<bool> cloudIsMagicWordProtected()` — in-folder-then-root lookup (mirrors restore()), downloads bytes, _codec.readHeaderOrNull(bytes), returns header?.isMagicWord == true; fail-open (false on any error); never decrypts payload or writes.

New failure: `class EmptyBackupFailure extends Failure { const EmptyBackupFailure([super.message = 'No contacts to back up']); }` in lib/core/errors/failure.dart.

_migrateDeleteRootIfSafe and _isReadableBackup are STILL used by backup() (migrate-then-delete block) — kept, no dead-code warnings.

NOTE for FEAT-003 (UI): I made a MINIMAL compile-only swap in lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/backup_screen.dart `_applyMagicWord` — `service.setMagicWordAndRepack(word)` -> `service.setMagicWord(word)` so analyze stays clean. The surrounding UI/messaging (still sets `_hasRemoteBackup = true`, still shows magicWordSavedRepacking/magicWordRepackFailed/magicWordSaved strings) is UNCHANGED and is FEAT-003/plan-item-4's job to redesign (persistent 'takes effect next backup' status, stop touching _hasRemoteBackup, drop the repacking strings).

Tests (test/unit/services/backup_service_test.dart): all 16 pass. 4 obsolete setMagicWordAndRepack tests removed; added setMagicWord-no-drive-op, setMagicWord-invalid, empty-guard (default + force:true), allowEmpty:true-uploads, restore override (success w/o persist + wrong->WrongMagicWordFailure), cloudBackupModifiedTime, cloudIsMagicWordProtected (magicword true / uid false / no-file false). FakeDriveRepository gained a settable `DateTime? backupModifiedTime` field (default null) returned by getBackupModifiedTime. The existing 'magicword mode' test now seeds one contact to clear the empty guard.

ENV NOTE (not committed): a fresh worktree has NO generated code (28 *.g.dart/*.freezed.dart are gitignored) and NO pubspec_overrides.yaml (gitignored). To build/analyze/test here I had to: (1) create pubspec_overrides.yaml pointing SecBizCard_OCR at the ABSOLUTE sibling path /Users/jack/_Projects/SecBizCard/packages/SecBizCard_OCR (the main repo's override uses `../SecBizCard` which is wrong from inside .worktrees/), then `fvm flutter pub get`; (2) run `fvm dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` once to materialize generated code. No @riverpod provider signatures changed. analyze = documented 5-issue baseline (firebase_options x2 + 3 zip_import_service_test warnings), no new issues.
